scope: Mech-independent Polish reference catalogue of all SRW OE 1.08 pilots, sub-pilots, rivals, bosses, base-only Pilot Statistics (SP, Atak, Obrona, Celność, Unik), Spirit Command tables with unlock level + SP cost + base effect (Slot | Duch | Poz. nauki | Koszt SP | Efekt bazowy), Pilot Skill tables with unlock level + base effect (Slot | Umiejętność | Poz. nauki | Efekt bazowy, without Lv2–Lv9 progressions or +krok steps), Ace Bonuses, and zero pilot [ID ...] badges (v4.0, Notepad++ aligned)
